name: northwind-hinglish-newsletter
description: Invented Hinglish marketing newsletter with urgency language and an unsubscribe line. Must stay low: bulk-mail suppression in the hinglish pack has to recognise the local unsubscribe vocabulary.

email.subject: Last chance: 20% off aaj raat khatam
email.bodyText:
Sale midnight ko khatam hoti hai. Poori range par 20% off pane ke liye abhi action lo.

Is mahine naya: refill tins aur free delivery.

Aap yeh email isliye receive kar rahe hain kyunki aapne northwind-roasters.example par sign up kiya. Unsubscribe ya email preferences manage karein. Browser mein dekhein.

Northwind Roasters
